headline: The Illusion of KOSPI 7000: More Stocks Fell Than Rose Each Time It Climbed [Why Is the Market...]
summary: KOSPI surpassed the 7,000 level again and surged 2.66%, yet more stocks fell than rose. Between the 16th and 23rd, declining stocks outnumbered advancing ones on all five days the index rose.
why: Narrow market breadth, where gains are concentrated in a few stocks, can signal fragile rallies. Investors monitor breadth alongside index levels to gauge market health.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The article analyses KOSPI's level and the breadth of its daily moves.
